purpose: Token-free external acquisition packet for target-scale TikTok creative creator leads.
source_url_strategy: Each assignment includes TikTok user/video search URLs, hashtag URLs when applicable, and search engine URLs for the same source query.

first_assignments.acceptance_rubric: public TikTok profile; original creative work; visible craft/process/finished creative output; not a repost, fan, spam, or brand-only account
